notes.title: V0.01 dev log #1 - Water physics, etc.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40273534/6a7e22fefe4f30e1d379344f005af20ffc027bbf.gif[/img]
​
Water physics is working, it can still be a bit glitchy or laggy if a lot of water needs to move at once. Consequently to recent changes, underwater has to remain blocky. It's unknown if underwater areas can or will ever be a smooth surface again, it's very likely it would be a poor use of time to try and support it going forward - in my opinion as a solo dev. The basic reason is after the voxels were made far more accurate to the surface, the water can no longer appear to share the same space as the sand, as they would actually need to do so. The good thing about keeping it this way is the BLOCKY game rule will continue to have full support and parity with the regular gameplay at least.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40273534/903c1b22e625caefd7ad5e8b6e7a8f7934a6a536.gif[/img]

Voxel mining has been added in V0.00 and since improved. Small vertical holes (up to 10ish cm) may still appear on thin slices near the surface, but it's close to being fixed. Block voxels mesh with the smooth surface much more closely and accurately.

Basic work to implement the first Dimension should be underway soon. DO NOT expect a full fledged dimension full of resources and enemies in V0.01 - this will strictly be a basic setup with a few unique blocks comprising the dimension, to be filled in with content later. Future dimensions will likely be held off entirely until they have a decent amount of resources, creatures, and content, before being accessible to the player. Doing it this way early on will help me to respond to feedback, as well as demonstrate continuous development on the game. You should be able to set up factories in every dimension, but they'll only run in the dimension you're currently in. Long-term though, concurrent multi-dimensional factories should be possible eventually. The base game has had dimension support from day 1 (as well as voxel support), this is just a matter of re-enabling and sometimes re-implementing certain things.

Planned Feature List for V0.01:
[list]
[*] Water physics
[*] 1st Dimension (To be named)
[*] Basic cooking machines (Oven and Microwave, microwave is much faster but maybe 0.6x status effects, 0.8x health, StC)
[*] Some kind of tasty creature that drops something that can be cooked
[*] Camera & Printer (Photos can be mounted on walls)
[*] Teleporter (costs resources to travel, the primary way to get to a dimension)
[*] Workshop (used to modify tools, use artifact stars to bring out unique properties of certain resources, StC)​
[/list]

StC= especially subject to change

The first update for V0.01 should be live well before the end of May, currently 19 days away.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Implemented mail, allowing us to share big news easier in-game (no internet required), as well as gifts of usually unobtainable, or useful items. Gift offers are subject to change at any time, and the offer expires after the date listed. Feel free to access your mail from other saves as well.
To access your mail/gifts please access your Esc menu [Esc] or (Start), and click mailbox on the side.

Other changes:
-Coppie button on Esc Menu now summons all tamed coppies to where you are, use with care. May open a menu in the future of all tamed creatures.
-Minimap now refreshes after 8 seconds on load (use the H key to force a refresh)
-/give command removed in order to give meaning to 'unobtainable' gifts/items. A sandbox or "Creative" mode may be implemented in time. If you still want the basic functionality, use /spawn instead. /spawn doesn't allow changing the materials something is made from

notes.title: Version 0.00 - Giant Hole fix + Known Issues
notes.content:
The issue where chunks don't load in (but water does) so there were huge holes in the ground occasionally, should be fixed now. Along with fixing the initial inventory being added again on subsequent loads of a new game.

Please tell me here or at support@vyrulent.com if you still experience this issue somehow. I'm sorry this happened and I'm not sure how it slipped past, but I can't always playtest extensively as I am currently a solo developer. As a thank you for being patient, the next hotfix will include a [b]gift[/b], available for a limited time. Please don't hesitate to tell me of issues even if they're obvious, neither you or myself should feel stupid for it. These things happen.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
-[u]new game spawns me in water[/u] (if you wait a few seconds it should teleport you to land)
There will be a fix coming once I've uncovered the best way to handle it, auto-teleporting is a dumb quick fix I implemented
-[u]new game spawns me under the world[/u]
Should be fixed now as I assume it was due to a missing chunk at spawn
-[u]extreme lag when looking at a chunk[/u]
This is new to me, I assume it's due to improper collision but needs more testing
-[u]mining slowdown after mining ~100 blocks in a single chunk[/u]
Working on this presently, collision builds weird with the smooth terrain
-[u]small holes in world (block missing a side)[/u]
Related to the previous 2 issues above, trying to simplify collision building and a few tiny holes are better than the lag. Will be attempting fixing very soon. This issue should only appear near the surface, any underground "holes" are probably actually a block that looks exactly like the sky, a Sky Block.
-[u]everything I placed is now duplicated on reload, oh God the lag![/u]
sincerely hope this is fixed, please email me immediately if you encounter this. Not sure if I ever learned the cause but it seems to have gone away, so I have no way of replicating it.
-[u]Coppies are annoying[/u]
they should be spawning less, have poorer eyesight, not jump in front of the player when tamed, but they are still terrible at aiming their jumps. So there's a bit of work to be done.
-[u]buried treasure appears above ground sometimes[/u]
I know the cause, I'm not too worried - see below
-[b][u]the giant rock formations get in the way of mining[/u][/b]
These may be removed entirely, now that there are proper voxels, these are also the things that cause the buried treasure chests to appear on the surface when generated. If you've managed to build on a rock formation, please take machines at least off, as a future update might break your grid if they're removed. They're more obnoxious than they ought to be, now that we have voxels.

Any other issues you're having - I am likely unaware of them, so please do let me know, I fix most issues I know the cause of within hours, and I check the posts/comments here.

Best,
-StarLight

notes.title: Version 0.00 Future Notes + evaporator fix
notes.content:
Modified water detection with Evaporators (any water block vertically along the pipe should trigger it being submerged)

Still working on optimization. Balancing and focusing on resource scarcity/availability will be done soon as well.

[b]Future balancing outline[/b] (subject to change):
Miners should "miss" (or output none) every so often in addition to being slow when mining with a softer metal.
I think rates from a lot of machines will be reduced or tuned. There may be extra junk generated by some machines (like when mining for gemstones)
Gemstone tipped miners and excavators will be very fast and "miss" far less (to be implemented)
undergound ore will be adjusted a bit
Hopefully with the voxel optimizations, quarries should be possible to implement without crazy lag, hopefully straightforward but challenging for the player.
Ideally quarries will use a bucket-wheel excavator with a moving conveyor and storing/sorting/processing all the resources should be very difficult.
Duplicating resources should be possible in some (legal) way involving Coppies (one reason for the name) even if that means a currency generated from them to be used to 'buy' blocks.
Obviously that's only one stray idea, but a value exchange duplicating system involving Coppies in some way that's not broken or dumb.
Demons/creatures implemented should be farmable but not spawn-farmable
Other dimensions implemented should have similar scarcity levels for all but a few things
I think the first Dimension will be introduced in V0.01 without much content, but future dimensions will likely be held off until they're full of things.
The MidWorld should be demon free and mostly peaceful apart from some that may slip through from other dimensions
There may be a teleport machine that ties into dimensional travel, and cats.

Please contact support@vyrulent.com if you have any issues.
If you're also somehow knee deep in scarcity theory feel free to chat starlight@vyrulent.com

-StarLight
